q: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

s: God stills seas (roaring of the seas and waves)
q: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

s: God stills turmoil of nations
q: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

s: God waters earth (enriches it greatly)
q: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it.

s: God provides rain and harvest (God's provision) (grain, as ordained)
q: You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

s: God has attribute awesome deeds
q: How awesome are your deeds!

s: Israel (the speaker's people, 'us') is brought to place of abundance (after fire and water)
q: We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

s: testing and refining of God's people is compared to refining of silver
q: You have refined us, as silver is refined.

s: testing and refining of God's people includes imprisonment
q: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

s: psalmist (speaker) intends to offer burnt offerings and vows (in God's temple)
q: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

s: psalmist (speaker) will declare what God has done for his soul (to all who fear God)
q: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

s: burnt offerings and vows was promised during distress (vows made by the psalmist)
q: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

s: burnt offerings and vows includes fat animals, rams, bulls and goats (offerings)
q: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats.

s: God rules by might (forever)
q: He rules by his might forever.

s: God watches nations (with his eyes)
q: His eyes watch the nations.

s: God preserves Israel (the speaker's people, 'us') (keeps their life and steadies their feet)
q: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
